caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical jar with a fitted lid, positioned upright at the center of the image. The jar and its lid are rendered in shades of beige and light brown, with subtle shading used to suggest roundness and a reflective surface. The jar has a broad, slightly convex body that narrows toward the top before meeting the horizontally flat lid, which features a small raised circular handle in the middle. The entire object is contained within a rectangular border drawn with a thin black line. The background is off-white and unadorned. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition.
title: Pottery Jar with Lid
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
